python3 << 'EOF'
# 0-indexed positions 0-35
# target pairs: (1,34)(2,33)(4,28)(5,27)(7,24)(8,23)(11,21)(12,20)(14,18)
# unpaired: 0,3,6,9,10,13,15,16,17,19,22,25,26,29,30,31,32,35
seq = list('A'*36)
pairs = [(1,34),(2,33),(4,28),(5,27),(7,24),(8,23),(11,21),(12,20),(14,18)]
# Use G-C for closing pairs (outermost of each stem) and C-G/C-G
# Stem1 (1,34)(2,33): G-C / C-G  -> pos1=G,pos34=C, pos2=C,pos33=G
# Stem2 (4,28)(5,27): G-C / C-G
# Stem3 (7,24)(8,23): G-C / C-G
# Stem4 (11,21)(12,20): G-C / C-G
# Lonely pair (14,18): C-G (closing triloop), cap GAA at 15,16,17
for (i,j) in pairs:
    seq[i]='G'; seq[j]='C'
# make second of each stem C-G pattern
seq[2]='C'; seq[33]='G'
seq[5]='C'; seq[27]='G'
seq[8]='C'; seq[23]='G'
seq[12]='C'; seq[20]='G'
# lonely pair (14,18): C-G closing triloop
seq[14]='C'; seq[18]='G'
# triloop cap GAA at 15,16,17
seq[15]='G'; seq[16]='A'; seq[17]='A'
# unpaired linkers A-rich
for p in [0,3,6,9,10,13,19,22,25,26,29,30,31,32,35]:
    seq[p]='A'
print(''.join(seq))
print(len(seq))
EOF
